content: अनुचरः .²1 A companion, follower, attendant, servant; तेनानुचरेण धेनोः <ls>R. 2. 4</ls>; आत्मानुचरस्य भावं जिज्ञासमाना <ls n="R. 2.">26</ls>, <ls n="R. 2.">52</ls>; <ls>Me. 3</ls>; विबुधानुचराः <ls>Ms. 12. 47</ls>. In <ab>comp.</ab> attended or followed by; वानर˚, राक्षस˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Following a spy (चरमनुगतः). .{@-रा, -री@} .²1 A female attendant. .²2 A logical or due strophe.
